name: AutoCorrect
description: Contains Microsoft Excel AutoCorrect attributes (capitalization of names of days, correction of two initial capital letters, automatic correction list, and so on).
example:
With Application.AutoCorrect
 .TwoInitialCapitals = True
 .ReplaceText = True
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: CapitalizeNamesOfDays
properties.description: True if the first letter of day names is capitalized automatically. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ReplacementList
properties.description: Returns the array of AutoCorrect replacements.

properties.name: ReplaceText
properties.description: True if text in the list of AutoCorrect replacements is replaced automatically. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TwoInitialCapitals
properties.description: True if words that begin with two capital letters are corrected automatically. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CorrectSentenceCap
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel automatically corrects sentence (first word) capitalization. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CorrectCapsLock
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel automatically corrects accidental use of the CapsLock key. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayAutoCorrectOptions
properties.description: Allows the user to display or hide the AutoCorrect Options button. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoExpandListRange
properties.description: A Boolean value indicating whether automatic expansion is enabled for lists. When you type in a cell of an empty row or column next to a list, the list will expand to include that row or column if automatic expansion is enabled. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoFillFormulasInLists
properties.description: Affects the creation of calculated columns created by automatic fill-down lists. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: AddReplacement
methods.signature: AddReplacement(What As String, Replacement As String) As Variant
methods.description: Adds an entry to the array of AutoCorrect replacements.

parameters.name: What
parameters.description: The text to be replaced. If this string already exists in the array of AutoCorrect replacements, the existing substitute text is replaced by the new text.

methods.name: DeleteReplacement
methods.description: Deletes an entry from the array of AutoCorrect replacements.

parameters.name: What
parameters.description: The text to be replaced, as it appears in the row to be deleted from the array of AutoCorrect replacements. If this string doesn't exist in the array of AutoCorrect replacements, this method fails.
